description.value: The Met is a bar and grill located on Columbia Street in downtown New Westminster, BC. Situated on one of the city's main commercial corridors, it is tagged in OpenStreetMap as wheelchair accessible. Beyond that, no further detail about the establishment is verifiable from available sources.
